name: Kelvin & Lori Ann Roche
reviewNotes:
No personal website or official social page found; Lori Ann also performs as Lori Ann Greenhouse. Demo videos exist only on a third-party YouTube channel.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Still no website or official business page: kldance.net no longer exists (DNS lookup fails). A hustle class guide links personal Instagram accounts @loriannroche and @kelvin.roche.71 for class info; they could not be checked without logging in and are individual accounts, so they are not recorded (owner may add them if wanted). Lesson phone (631) 332-8883 appears in their own Dance Calendar ad and the BOCES listing and is already on the kl-dance organizer; not repeated here, and the Hotmail address in the BOCES listing was not recorded. Only photo found is Kelvin's bio photo at Stepping Out Studios in Manhattan (where he also teaches); no photo of the two together on a studio site.
description: Kelvin and Lori Ann Roche are world hustle champions who teach hustle and Latin hustle group classes on Thursday nights at JLR Dance Unlimited in Bay Shore. They also teach, perform and judge at hustle events around the country.

photos.alt: Kelvin Roche smiling in a blue suit, cream vest and dark tie

Hustle class guide lists Thursday hustle classes with Kelvin and Lori Ann at JLR Dance Unlimited, 5 5th Avenue, Bay Shore (7 PM and 8 PM levels).
